explanation: Enhanced soft particles depth-test against the multisampled depth of an opaque instanced prop drawn earlier in the frame. Every draw input that WebGL exposes is identical in both builds: programs, uniforms, buffers, texture contents at every level, sampler and fixed-function state. Disabling the depth test for blended draws makes the builds agree. A few edge pixels of those particles then differ by one level in one channel. Each bound is the largest count measured at any capture point of that case; any other difference, a larger count or a larger channel delta fails.
